description: This file defines extension methods for JSON serialization and deserialization using System.Text.Json, providing convenience methods for converting objects to and from JSON strings.

classes.name: JsonExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for JSON serialization and deserialization with customizable options.

methods.name: FromJson<T>
methods.description: Converts a JSON string to an object of type T using predefined JsonSerializerOptions.

methods.name: ToJson<T>
methods.description: Serializes an object of type T to a JSON string using predefined JsonSerializerOptions.
